verdict.rationale: The API docs show a multi-framework architecture: a Frameworks resource with 'Create Custom Framework' and 'Create Framework Requirements', plus control-to-requirement mapping and comparison endpoints. This implies one platform can carry several frameworks, but nothing in the pack names HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as supported out of the box. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of prebuilt HIPAA, GDPR and PCI DSS frameworks, documentation of cross-framework control reuse in practice, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
